scripts.check: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p publishing-worker/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run build && node --test tests/*.test.ts publishing-worker/tests/*.test.ts
scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler dev --config publishing-worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config publishing-worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config publishing-worker/wrangler.toml
